meta.description: Append-only execution log for CICD/todo.json. One entry per action taken (command run, file changed, git operation), timestamped, per plan §9.
meta.format_note: Entries are appended chronologically and never rewritten or removed once written.

entries.detail: Consolidated all prior analysis and audit findings into FolioDesk_Consolidated_Plan.md (404 lines). Ran 3 automated consistency-check passes plus 1 manual re-read; fixed 3 confirmed inconsistencies (§7.3.1 cross-reference format, orphaned Finding F-03, orphaned Finding F-12) and 1 stray legacy reference ('CICD item T-002' -> 'Finding F-04 (§6.3)'). Final pass reported zero remaining issues.

Initial attempt to transfer FolioDesk_Consolidated_Plan.md to device via gzip+base64+device_bash heredoc failed with gunzip CRC/length error; resulting device-side file was 410 lines (corrupted) vs. source's 404 lines.

Retried transfer of FolioDesk_Consolidated_Plan.md using device_commit_files with stagedPath under /mnt/user-data/outputs/ (container-to-device path), force=true to overwrite the corrupted file. Verified post-transfer on device via device_bash: wc -l = 404, md5sum = 30aeb6a0d8419eb416391a74b8ec711c, matching the source exactly.

Created CICD/todo.json: 33 tasks across 6 phases (schema migrations; hard-prerequisite fixes; maker-checker auth/tooling; the four maker-checker flow changes; remaining §8 priority fixes; verification/reconciliation/cutover). Validated: all 17 Finding IDs (F-01..F-17) referenced at least once, no duplicate task IDs, no broken depends_on references.
Created CICD/log.json (this file) as the append-only execution log referenced by plan §9.

Phase 1 (schema migrations): added MANAGEMENT to users.role enum, created maker_checker_requests table, added PENDING_MANAGEMENT_APPROVAL to affiliate_applications.status enum. Applied directly to db/mysql-schema.sql plus 3 standalone files in CICD/migrations/ (001-003). All additive, statically checked only per §9 constraint (no live DB reachable).

Phase 2 (hard prerequisites, plan §7.8): wrapped approveDealCollection() and settleConsolidatedPayout() in DB transactions (conn.beginTransaction/commit/rollback, matching app/api/register/route.ts's existing pattern) to fix F-01. Added optional 'executor' parameter to findUplineChain() so it participates in the caller's transaction. Fixed F-08 by adding deal_pipeline.status_before_force_closure column (migration 004, additive) -- forceCloseDeal() now snapshots the deal's true pre-closure status, and adjudicateDealAppeal() restores it on appeal approval instead of hardcoding 'PROPOSAL_SENT'.
entries.verification_note: No TypeScript compiler runnable in this environment (local tsc binary is Windows-native, requires node.exe not present in the device_bash Linux sandbox). Verified structurally instead: brace/paren balance check on lib/funnel.ts (112/112 braces, 262/262 parens), confirmed all 16 exported functions still present and in original order, confirmed no other callers of findUplineChain() were broken by its new optional parameter. Full type-check must be run manually (or via CI) before this branch is considered mergeable.

entries.detail: Phase 3: added requireManagement() to lib/auth.ts; fixed F-05 (users.status desync for RETRACTED/RETRACTION_ACKNOWLEDGED); built ADMIN-only /admin/users role-management screen and /api/admin/users route enforcing strict, permanent, org-wide separation of duties between ADMIN and MANAGEMENT (checked against current role + full audit_events role-change history). Added nav link in AdminNav.tsx.

git status/git commit calls in the FolioDesk/../Websites outer repo working tree are slow (large tree, many pre-existing modified/untracked files) and can exceed a 120s tool timeout even when they eventually succeed. Encountered a second stale index.lock (0-byte, no running git process, same signature as the earlier documented incident) after a timed-out compound command. Removed it after confirming via `ps aux` that no git process was running, then retried with a longer timeout and the commit succeeded cleanly (6 files, exactly the intended set). No data was lost; the earlier `git add` had actually succeeded despite its wrapping command reporting a timeout.

T-401: Admin collection-approve route now submits a maker_checker_requests row instead of approving directly; new app/api/management/collections/[id]/decide/route.ts (MANAGEMENT-only) approves-as-submitted or rejects. CollectionsApprovalView.tsx updated with 'PENDING MANAGEMENT REVIEW' badge and submit-for-approval copy (mc_request_status join added to page.tsx query).

T-402 (highest-risk flow): both single-advice and batch payout disbursement routes now submit maker_checker_requests instead of writing payout_status='PAID' directly. New app/api/management/payouts/decide/route.ts (MANAGEMENT-only, takes requestId in body since it disambiguates single vs batch entity types) executes settleConsolidatedPayout() (batch) or a guarded direct UPDATE (single) on approval. F-02 fixed: re-flip guard added to both the new single-settlement path and the separate CANCEL_PAYOUT action (WHERE payout_status='PENDING_DISBURSEMENT'). F-03 fixed: PayoutsView.tsx's Disburse button condition rebuilt as isDisbursable (excludes PAID, CANCELLED, and advices already pending Management review) instead of the old isPaid-only check. F-11 fixed on this form: disabled/loading state added to the disbursement submit button.

T-403: only the APPROVED transition in the admin application-decision route is now gated -- it sets affiliate_applications.status='PENDING_MANAGEMENT_APPROVAL' (no affiliate_code assigned yet, no decided_at) and submits a maker_checker_requests row instead of approving directly; the other 8 decision values (REJECTED, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, RETRACTED, RETRACTION_ACKNOWLEDGED, etc.) proceed through the original code path unchanged, including the F-05 users.status fix from T-303. New app/api/management/applications/[id]/decide/route.ts (MANAGEMENT-only): on APPROVE, generates affiliate_code (if not already assigned, e.g. on a reinstatement), sets status='APPROVED', decided_at=NOW(), and users.status='ACTIVE'/role='AFFILIATE'; on REJECT, reverts affiliate_applications.status to 'UNDER_REVIEW' (non-terminal -- Management disagreeing with the Admin's recommendation, not a decision about the applicant) with the reason logged to application_status_history. AdminNetworkView.tsx updated with PENDING_MANAGEMENT_APPROVAL badge styling and 'Awaiting Management decision' button-area copy; Approve/Reactivate button text changed to 'Submit for Approval'.

T-404: force-closure appeal adjudication now routes through maker_checker_requests. In app/api/admin/deals/[id]/closure/route.ts, FORCE_CLOSE and EXTEND_DIRECT actions are left completely unchanged (out of scope per plan §7.3(4)); ADJUDICATE_APPEAL no longer calls adjudicateDealAppeal() directly -- it checks for an existing PENDING request (entity_type='deal_pipeline', request_type='CLOSURE_APPEAL_ADJUDICATION') then submits one with payload {dealId, isApproved, daysExtended, notes}. New app/api/management/deals/[id]/closure/decide/route.ts (MANAGEMENT-only): on APPROVE, calls adjudicateDealAppeal() with the exact payload the Admin submitted (Management confirms-as-submitted, cannot silently change days), then re-reads deal_pipeline.status to report the actual restored stage (leveraging the T-203/F-08 fix that populates status_before_force_closure) rather than assuming a fixed outcome; on REJECT, does NOT call adjudicateDealAppeal() -- appeal_status is left untouched at APPEAL_SUBMITTED so the appeal remains open for the Admin to resubmit a different recommendation. DealDetailView.tsx appeal modal updated: title changed to 'Review Extension Appeal', added a maker-checker notice box, submit button changed to 'Submit Recommendation for Management Sign-off'. This completes all four of the plan's mandatory maker-checker flows (T-401 through T-404).
